fields.statement: At 4f54a51 ran go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-resume|describe-golden|inbox.*)$' -count=1: all pass. daemon-resume.txtar has interrupted runs on a landed (LANDED00001) and a draft (DRAFT000001) change set; daemon --once opens no Rex tab and journals no daemon-resumed for either, then rhiza inbox lists 'skipped run LANDED00001, change set ...', 'interrupted, and not resumed: its change set is landed', 'next: rhiza run abandon LANDED00001' (and the draft one), not the resumed INTERRUPTED1; abandoning LANDED00001 clears it. Diff (internal/api/inbox.go) adds InboxSkipped for a dead, not daemon-resumed, unblocked run whose change set state is known and not accepted, matching the daemon's accepted-only resume. make check: fmt, vet and go test pass; self-check fails only on a stale .rhiza/rendered from an earlier run's actor record, not this leaf.
